messages:
alex: Heads up — proposing a 'Notify Policy Editor' UI in Console so SREs/product can map SLO/alert rules to prioritized notification lanes (email, slack, pager). Currently it's config-as-code only and messy.
mina: +1. We need per-route overrides and suppression windows. Right now noise from low-priority routes floods infra oncall.
chao: Question: should editor allow debounce/quorum settings? e.g., require X% of instances to be failing before paging.
alex: yes — think about two axes: severity->channel mapping, and trigger-filters (quorum, sustained duration, rate threshold). Also need global and per-tenant controls.
emily: UX: show a live preview of who will be notified given a tenant and active silences. Important for sales and security reviews (they ask who will see a page).
product-ops: Also need audit log + ability to pin policies for Private deployments. For on-prem customers we must show KMS keys in the audit trail and provide an export.
sre-bot: [policy-service] audit: user alex created draft notify-policy "team-paging-v2" (preview available)
mina: Implementation suggestion: keep a canonical policy graph in control plane, expose PATCH API /v1/notify-policies/{id} and a dry-run endpoint /v1/notify-policies/_preview. Provide server-side validation against tenant-level locks.
chao: Can we get a tiny example schema?
alex: example YAML (draft):
```
id: team-paging-v2
match:
  slo: service_latency_p99
  route_prefix: /api/v1/
filters:
  sustained: 5m
  rate_threshold: 10/min
  quorum: 0.6
actions:
  - severity: critical
    channel: pagerduty
    escalate_after: 10m
  - severity: warning
    channel: #eng-oncall
    notify_once: true
```
emily: Nice. Telemetry: we should surface metrics in Console like `expected_notification_targets`, `policy_evaluations_total`, and `policy_misses` (when alerts fire but no policy matched). Those will help debug why someone didn't get a page.
mina: And add an 'effectiveness' metric: percent of alerts that were resolved without escalation after first notification. Could be useful to tune debounce.
alex: For rollout: feature-flag the Console UI + API. We'll default to read-only for 2 weeks, then allow edits for internal teams, then GA. Need a migration script to translate existing YAML configs into the canonical policy graph.
product-ops: Put a migration + rollback plan in the PR. Also add a checkbox in Console for 'enforce tenant overrides' so customer success can toggle safe-mode.
chao: Quick question about noise suppression: do we want centralized suppression windows or allow tenant-local windows?
mina: Both. Centralized for org-level incidents, tenant-local for customer-specific maintenance. UI should let you pick scope when creating a silence.
alex: I'll draft the RFC and mockups today and open a PR for API endpoints. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT? @emily @chao please confirm.
product-ops: On the calendar. Add a short pre-read listing migration steps and sample queries for telemetry.
chao: 👍
